$comment: Playwright tests that are red without anyone's current change. The list is a ratchet: `count` may sink, never rise. Raise it only on an explicit instruction. Every entry must point at an existing spec and an existing test title - tests/playwright-known-failures.contract.test.mjs enforces that, so a fixed or renamed test forces the entry out.
